records.claim: More Qatari LNG cargoes transited Hormuz over the weekend despite continuing security risks.
records.observation: The recovery pattern continues without restoration of normal route conditions.

records.claim: Japan said it had no plans for a new national-reserve release after previous releases, despite the G7 coordinated commitment.
records.observation: The collective buffer is being implemented against different national baselines rather than as identical new releases by every member.
records.assessment: PERSISTENT implementation detail, not a fresh delta.

records.claim: Naftogaz is considering five Siemens Energy gas-turbine compressor units and Ukraine discussed 12 gas-turbine units for distributed generation; values and delivery dates were not disclosed.
records.observation: The October 4 cooperation is gaining technical definition but has not crossed into procurement or deployment.

records.claim: More than 160 Apache offshore workers backed industrial action that Unite says could disrupt the Forties pipeline system.
records.observation: A labour risk has become credible but no physical pipeline disruption is yet reported.
